faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does your damaged vehicle purchase process work?
faq.a1: You fill out the form, our expert evaluates the vehicle condition and makes you an offer as soon as possible. If agreed, we pick up the vehicle and make payment.
faq.q2: Does the vehicle need to be seen physically to get a quote?
faq.a2: No. We provide an initial quote based on photos and descriptions. Physical inspection is only done at the handover stage.
faq.a3: We serve throughout Turkey. We buy vehicles in all cities, especially Istanbul, Ankara, and Izmir.
faq.a4: Yes. We also evaluate vehicles that have been written off by insurance.
faq.q5: Can I sell a vehicle with a tow certificate?
faq.a5: Yes. We buy all types of damaged vehicles including those with tow certificates and provide paperwork support.
faq.a6: No. Our quotes are completely non-binding, the vehicle owner can withdraw at any time.
faq.a7: Payment is made immediately after vehicle handover and paperwork completion.
faq.a8: Yes. You can reach us via WhatsApp 7 days a week.
